newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Prompt enquiries support Singapore bunker levels.
newsitem.headline: Prompt enquiries support Singapore bunker levels.

text.p: Singapore bunker levels were supported on Friday despite weakness in the cargo market, traders said.

Prices were steady over some prompt enquiries, they said. "Some shipowners are asking for as early as end-June lifting cargoes," said one independent supplier, adding that he expected to fix 380-cst parcels at $99 per tonne later.
Bunker 380-cst was quoted at $98/$100 per tonne. MDO and gas oil were at around $173 and $184 respectively.
